author: paper-design
name: heatmap
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Heatmap style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 6-color palette (#000000, #11206A, #2F63E7, #6BD7FF, #FFE679, #FF4C00). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
